attributes.residual:
NONE - real 0, byte-equal to the target, machine-asserted at every build by apply_patch's after_sha256 (which is the sha256 of the TARGET function bytes).

WHY THIS FUNCTION AND NOT camera_mode_level. The census (WF_scratch/wf_census.py, 2835 equal-size paired functions read from RAW .postprocess/body output with the five shipped composed rules as canaries, all five FOUND) classifies every differing word image-wide: other 9057, regfield 7859, inv_rc 47, fwd_rc 44, fwd 5, inv 2. The PURE inverse direction - ours copy, target li, destination already equal - has exactly TWO sites image-wide, in fn_8001267C (+0x1e8) and game/pb/dbgtext::fn_800C03E0. That is the entire positional payoff, and it is why the census had to be run before the build: the direction the work order named is genuinely tiny.

THE POSITIONAL CENSUS UNDERCOUNTS IT, which is the finding that made this close possible. fn_8001267C's SECOND inverse site, +0x380, is invisible to any positional scan: before the permutation that offset holds our `extsh r28,r29`, and the site only becomes an inverse copy/li pair after window 3 moves the words. A positional census reads it as an ordinary regfield row. So the true inverse population is at least 2 sites larger than the census reports and the correct way to hunt the rest is to cluster first and classify after permutation.

THE FUNCTION CLOSES AS: three permutation windows ([0x178,0x180) order [1,0]; [0x1e0,0x1ec) order [1,0,2]; [0x378,0x384) order [2,0,1]), two inverse-form rewrites (+0x1e8 our `mr r5,r3` -> `li r5,0`, proved against the `li r3,0` window 2 places at +0x1e4; +0x380 our `addi r27,r26,0` -> `li r27,0`, proved against the `li r26,0` window 3 places at +0x37c), then copy_register_fields over the remaining 32 pure register fields. verify_consistent_recolor ACCEPTS the whole function. NO unproven_recolor_audit, no escape hatch, no guard weakened.

WINDOW 1 IS THE NON-OBVIOUS ONE AND IS RECORDED AS ITS OWN LAW (claim.law.WF_a-register-transposition-can-be-byte-invisible-at-its-own-definitions.20260901.v1). Its two words are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the target, so the raw diff shows nothing there; without it verify_consistent_recolor refuses at +0x1c8 with `use of g3 does not correspond to g4 under the running renaming'. An earlier draft of this rule shipped that refusal under unproven_recolor_audit; the audit was REMOVED once window 1 was found, so the escape hatch was not needed and was not used.
